findings.summary: A failed query shows the wrong thing: Library grid says 'Your library is empty', Notes and Note render blank forever, game detail spins forever. No error or retry anywhere
Loading is a centred spinner (grid, game detail) or nothing at all (notes, note: return null)
Game detail 'unavailable' (offline/failed) is a dead end: message only, no retry

findings.summary: Game detail: the whole editor (7 sections) is one card, and Notes, the app's signature feature, sits under it, about 2 screens down. 'In your library · Playing' repeats the selected status chip
Library filter row: once scrolled, the active sort and filter are off-screen and there's no clear-all. Every cell repeats the status even when filtered to that status
Pushed scrollables outside the tab bar (game detail, notes, archive) pad the bottom with 16-24pt, not the home-indicator inset (static; needs a scroll-to-end check)
11 of 13 Pressables give no press feedback (Chip, CoverCell, StatusChips, NoteRow, NotesLink, tag pills, text buttons, stars)
The note text field has only a placeholder, no visible label (the location field below it has one)
Notes filter row mixes two dimensions (Open/All/Resolved and note type) in one identical chip row
The star is a text glyph in the Favourites chip and in cells, while the rest of the app uses Ionicons
Status dot size drifts between 7, 8 and 10; chip border width between 1 and 1.5
The toast sits 64pt above the bottom on every screen, including pushed ones with no tab bar
findings.notVerifiedLive: toast needs an action to trigger
